statement_en: Let $G$ be a graph on $n$ vertices, $\alpha_1(G)$ be the maximum number of edges that contain at most one edge from every triangle, and $\tau_1(G)$ be the minimum number of edges that contain at least one edge from every triangle. Is it true that\[\alpha_1(G)+\tau_1(G) \leq \frac{n^2}{4}?\]
